question: If the 4-digit number x67y is exactly divisible by 9, then the least value of (x + y) is_____.
solution:
Given: 

The 4 digit number x67y is exactly divisible by 9,

Concept Used:

If the number is divisible by 9 so sum of the number is also divisible by 9

Calculation:

x67y is exactly divisible by 9

The sum of its digits must be divisible by 9

x + 6 + 7 + y = x + y + 13 is divisible by 9

Minimum value x + y must be equal to 5 because then the sum will be 18 and it is divisible by 9.

∴ The least value of (x + y) is 5.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__

The possible value of x and y can be

x = 5, y = 0

x = 4, y = 1

x = 3, y = 2

x = 2, y = 3

x = 1, y = 4

x = 0, y = 5 -- In this case the number became 3 digit number so, this case is not consider.
